mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Liberate the designated Cyborg-occupied planets to disrupt an election-impeding cyberattack.
mo_brief.translated: 解放指定的生化人占领星球，以瓦解一场意图阻挠选举的网络攻击。

items.original:
INCINERATION CORPS SIGHTED

The Automaton Incineration Corps has resurfaced on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
items.translated:
发现炽灼部队

机器人炽灼部队已在文德米塔里克斯主星重新出现。

items.original:
JET BRIGADE SIGHTED

The Automaton Jet Brigade has resurfaced on AURORA BAY.
items.translated:
发现喷气旅

机器人喷气旅已在极光湾重新出现。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Intercepted Cyborg communications indicate an upcoming cyberattack designed to impede election Management for the upcoming Quarter-term elections. 

It is believed these assaults will originate from MegafactorIes on CHARBAL-VII and ZZANIAH PRIME. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate these planets immediately.
items.translated:
新重要指令

截获的生化人通讯表明，即将发生一场旨在阻碍下一季度选举管理工作的网络攻击。

据信这些攻击将源自查巴尔 VII 和藏尼亚主星上的超大型工厂。绝地潜兵奉命立即解放这些星球。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED

Eagle Gas Airstrike  Stratagem availability has now ended.
items.translated:
军械扩充结束

“飞鹰毒气空袭”战略的可用性现已结束。

items.original:
HEETH LOST
Heeth has fallen to the Terminid Menace. We cannot allow this infestation to continue to spread.
items.translated:
希斯失守
希斯已落入终结族威胁之手。我们不能让这场虫患继续蔓延。

items.original:
CAMPAIGN WON

TCS+ nodes are under construction on BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43 following their liberation by the Helldivers. The containment of the Terminids has never been more guaranteed. The dissident network responsible for these sabotages, which existed, has been dismantled.
items.translated:
战役胜利

在绝地潜兵解放博尔岩和尼维尔43后，TCS+节点正在这两颗星球上建设。对终结族的遏制从未如此有保障。负责这些破坏活动的异议分子网络（该网络确实存在）已被瓦解。

items.original:
HEETH UNDER ATTACK
The bugs have attacked Heeth. Rally to its defense, before they are able to permanently infest it.
items.translated:
希斯遭受攻击

虫族已攻击希斯。在它们能够永久侵染之前，集结力量保卫它。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

High Command has authorized fleetwide availability of the Eagle Gas Airstrike  Stratagem for the next 72 hours.
items.translated:
军械扩充

最高指挥部已授权在未来72小时内，全舰队可使用“飞鹰毒气空袭”战略。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Recent sabotages of the TCS+ by dissidents have threatened the populace and inflamed public outrage. 

The Helldivers are ordered to liberate BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43, Terminid-held planets adjacent to those sabotaged by dissidents, so that the TCS+ can be built on those planets as well. In so doing, the impregnable barrier of the TCS+ will be made twice as impregnable as before.
items.translated:
新重要指令

异议分子近期对TCS+的破坏活动威胁到了民众安全，激起了公愤。

绝地潜兵奉命解放博尔岩和尼维尔43——这两颗被终结族占领的星球紧邻遭异议分子破坏的星球，以便TCS+也能在这些星球上建设。如此一来，坚不可摧的TCS+屏障将变得比以往更加坚不可摧。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Deputized citizens have apprehended thousands of suspected dissidents across the Federation. They were motivated and rewarded by premium trophies of Freedom's enemies valiantly secured by the Helldivers.

Hundreds of apprehended suspects have already confessed to conspiracy to sabotage the TCS+ and destroy Managed Democracy. The dissident network, which existed, is rapidly being mapped and dismantled.
items.translated:
重要指令完成

被授权的公民已在联邦各地逮捕了数千名疑似异见分子。他们因绝地潜兵英勇夺取的自由之敌的珍贵战利品而受到激励和奖赏。

数百名被捕嫌疑人已承认密谋破坏TCS+并摧毁管理式民主。这个确实存在的异见网络正在被迅速绘制并瓦解。
